query: Last weekend I took my golden retriever to the new dog park near downtown, and he had so much fun chasing a frisbee that he ended up falling asleep as soon as we got in the car to go home. I also tried that viral matcha latte recipe from TikTok the other day, and while it was a little too sweet for my taste, it was still way better than the one I bought at the café down the street. Oh, and I finally got around to planting the tomato seedlings I bought last month, and they already have tiny little buds on them!
